pages.title: Nanite Swarm
pages.text: A billion machines the size of viruses, each one able to grab, move and bond individual atoms. Together they can build or unbuild almost anything, and they are hungry for raw material. The swarm looks like a grey cloud that shimmers at the edges.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Nanite Assembler, I programmed a Maxwell's Demon Chip to sort atoms, then gave it quantum dots for sight and neutronium for hands. It began copying itself. Wild swarms drop the same, which worried me.
